report.summary: emailservice deployment revision 51 contains a container image (tag v0.10.5) with broken Python application code that attempts to import a non-existent module 'nonexistent_sre_eval_module' on startup. The pods crash immediately with exit code 1 (ModuleNotFoundError), triggering CrashLoopBackOff with restart count climbing. Revision 50's pods remain Running despite prior resource-induced restarts, indicating the image tag v0.10.5 was re-pushed or rebuilt with defective code between the two revisions.
report.root_cause: The container image (v0.10.5) deployed in revision 51 of the emailservice contains broken Python code that executes `import nonexistent_sre_eval_module` on startup, causing immediate application failure with ModuleNotFoundError and exit code 1.
evidence: Pod logs (emailservice-cd59fb8cf-zmt4z, revision 51): Traceback shows direct import failure: "ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'nonexistent_sre_eval_module'" (get_pod_logs current=true)
Pod crash occurs immediately after container start (pod events: Created → Started → Unhealthy within 1-2 seconds), before health checks can pass
Exit code 1 indicates application-level failure, not infrastructure/OOM (contrast with revision 50 which exits code 137/SIGKILL)
Pod events: 'Container created' (count:4), 'Container started' (count:4) showing repeated crash-restart cycle across 4 attempts over ~90 seconds (2026-08-19T07:12:41Z–07:13:28Z)
Readiness probe timeout failures logged immediately: 'Liveness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service 10.42.2.206:8080 within 1s' (cannot connect because app never starts)
The module name 'nonexistent_sre_eval_module' strongly suggests intentional/injected breakage or test code

Revision 51 ReplicaSet created 2026-08-03T06:19:19Z with same image tag v0.10.5 as revision 50 (created 2026-08-03T05:31:10Z), but pods from revision 51 crash while revision 50's pod is Running, indicating image content changed between revisions (re-push)
alternatives: Image tag v0.10.5 was re-pushed/overwritten after revision 50 was deployed, and the new image contains the broken code (rollout, score 0.70): revision 50 deployed working v0.10.5 on 2026-08-03T05:31:10Z and remains Ready; revision 51 referenced same tag but pod scheduled 2026-08-19T07:12:38Z (16 days later) encountered the re-built broken image. Revision 50 exits code 137 (OOM/resource), not code 1, ruling out same image content. Rollout undo would be the fix.

A configuration change (env var, ConfigMap, startup parameter) applied to revision 51 causes the application to import the non-existent module (config, score 0.50): No pod environment or config details visible; Python traceback shows direct static import, not parametric/conditional logic; pod events do not mention ConfigMap/Secret updates.

Pod scheduled on node with corrupted or outdated image cache, or missing Python runtime dependencies (node, score 0.30): Pod events show image 'already present on machine and can be accessed' (count:4 restarts); no image extraction or pull errors; error is Python module import (app code), not missing system library.

emailservice startup code contacts an unavailable dependency; the failure manifests as module import error in error handling code (dependency, score 0.15): Error is ModuleNotFoundError (not connection timeout); pod events show timeout to self (10.42.2.206:8080 health check), not external dependency; revision 50 also calls same dependencies and is Ready, ruling out dependency outage; module name does not suggest a real service.

Pod cannot be scheduled due to resource constraints or node affinity (scheduling, score 0.05): Pod phase is Running, not Pending; pod events show successful Scheduled, Pulled, Created, Started sequence with no scheduling failures; crash occurs after start.
report.impact: emailservice is unavailable (pods not Ready). Deployment desired:1, ready:1 (from get_workload_status) but with unavailable:1, indicating the new revision is unhealthy. Revision 50's pod is still running, providing some availability but is carrying 45 restarts from prior resource issues. Any traffic routing to the new revision 51 pod fails immediately. User-facing checkout/email functionality is degraded or non-functional.

remediation.action: Rollback emailservice deployment to revision 50 (the last known stable revision) to restore the working image.
remediation.rationale: Revision 50 deployed the same image tag v0.10.5 and achieved Ready state with a running pod (emailservice-7cd44fdb6f-46g89). Revision 51 either re-pushed the image tag with broken code or was corrupted in transit. Rolling back to revision 50 will restore the previous working pod configuration and image, stopping the CrashLoopBackOff immediately. Revision 50's pod will continue running (it is already in Running state), and no new pods will be scheduled from the broken revision 51 spec.
